reasoning: This is a multi-component Models-as-a-Service platform, and its central component is maas-controller, a Kubernetes operator. maas-controller defines its own CRDs (MaaSModelRef, MaaSAuthPolicy, MaaSSubscription, MaasTenantConfig, AITenant, Config, ExternalModel) under maas-controller/api/maas. Its reconcilers deploy and manage the maas-api workload through Server-Side Apply of embedded kustomize manifests, and they turn the custom resources into Kuadrant AuthPolicies, TokenRateLimitPolicies and HTTPRoutes. The repo also contains services that the controller deploys: maas-api, a Go REST API backed by PostgreSQL with an OpenAPI spec, and maas-discovery, a discovery service. The README says the controller deploys maas-api automatically through its Tenant reconciler, so the whole repo is best classified as an operator that ships its own managed services.
